title: HQ cannot see whether a gym's automatic reminders and pop-ups went out
what: A gym's page in HQ shows members, check-ins, takings, orders, staff and sign-in counts, but nothing about the messages the system sends for that gym on its own: renewal reminders, birthday wishes, member pop-ups and admin app alerts. When an owner calls to say members never got their reminders, HQ has no record of what went, to whom, when, or why one did not.
expected: The gym page shows the gym's automatic sends of the last days: how many went, how many failed and why, without member names unless support access is open.
how_often: whenever a gym asks about its reminders
fix_line: Add a count of sent and failed automatic messages to the gym page

title: After a reply, pressing Save on the same feedback puts it back to New
what: Sending a reply marks the message Done on the server, but the card is not redrawn and its status box still shows the old status, such as New. If you then add a note and press Save, the old status is written back, and the message returns to Needs you as new feedback to read, although it was answered.
expected: After a reply the card shows Done, so a later Save keeps it Done.
how_often: when a note is added after a reply
fix_line: Redraw the card, or set its status box to Done, after a reply is sent

title: A new lead can arrive with no sound when another is handled in the same minute
what: The sound and pop-up come only when a count goes up since the last minute's check. Saving a lead, checking a gym or confirming a payment does not ask Needs you again, so the menu number and tab title stay one too high for up to a minute. If a new lead or payment arrives in that minute, the count looks unchanged, and it comes in silently with no pop-up.
expected: Handling an item updates the number at once, and an alert compares which items are new, not just how many.
how_often: rarely, when two things happen in one minute
fix_line: Refresh Needs you after every save and alert on new items, not on counts

title: A lead whose gym signs up by itself stays a new lead to call
what: A lead leaves the new list only when HQ changes its status by hand, or when the gym is made from the lead inside HQ. If the gym owner signs up on their own after asking for a demo, nothing links the two: Needs you counts both a new lead to call and a new gym to check for the same gym, and the Leads page does not show that this number already has a gym. You may call a gym that is already a customer and pitch it a demo.
expected: A lead whose phone number already owns a gym is marked as signed up, and leaves the to-call count.
how_often: each lead that signs up on its own
fix_line: Match leads to gyms by owner phone and mark them signed up
